components.name: Hero Action
components.description: The direct, high-priority action at the start of a manual section.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { min-height: 3.45rem; padding: 0 1.1rem; color: #173247; background: #f7d54b; border: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 7px 7px 0 rgb(9 32 43 / 35%); font: 700 .7rem ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { background: #fff0a4; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(210 79 56 / 82%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalog Search
components.description: A square paper search field for filtering the catalog.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; gap: .55rem; align-items: center; width: 16rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 .75rem; color: #173247; background: #fffdf4; border: 1px solid #173247; border-radius: 0; font: .78rem Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #d24f38; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgb(210 79 56 / 25%); }

components.name: Inventory Status
components.description: A compact square label for product availability.
components.css: .ds-stock { display: inline-flex; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; padding: .35rem .55rem; color: #173247; background: #d9e5d4; border: 1px solid #6b8169; border-radius: 0; font: .64rem ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-stock i { width: .35rem; height: .35rem; background: #4d9877; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Entry Field

narrative.overview: Stockroom is an operational catalog workspace with the physical logic of a well-used product reference manual: warm board beneath the page, a yellow divider rail, an ink-blue title sheet, and visible binding holes. The catalog is a paper leaf held beside a translucent green entry sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Warm board ground and strong horizontal/vertical rules.
Deep blue as the principal editorial field and text color.
Yellow reserved for divider-rail energy, summary metrics, and the primary hero action.
Square, bounded controls with punch-hole and acetate signatures.

rules.name: The Yellow Rail Rule
rules.body: Divider Yellow stays concentrated in rails, metrics, and the direct hero CTA. Do not use it as a general card background or body-text color.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Use serif for named, editorial hierarchy; use mono for machine-like operational labels. Do not turn all interface copy into display type.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation only when it is actionable, inset, or modal.

dos: Do retain the warm board, yellow rail, and ink-rule skeleton on every Stockroom operating surface.
Do use paper and acetate layers to separate catalog review from product entry.
Do preserve serif headings with monospaced labels and controls.
donts: Don't introduce pill-shaped buttons, rounded cards, glassmorphism, or generic floating dashboard panels.
Don't use yellow as a broad decorative backdrop outside its rail, metrics, and primary-action roles.
Don't use a soft shadow vocabulary for ordinary content cards.
